doc:
Item 11.2: zero-shot evaluation of the MEVID-trained encoders on the official LaST test protocol (10,176 query images,
125,353 gallery images including the unlabelled distractor folder 000000; 5,805 query identities; dataset page
github.com/shuxjweb/last, public Google Drive download, 'academic research use only', no form). Protocol as in the dataset
authors' loader (data/datasets/last.py and eval_reid.py): every image has a unique camera id, so no gallery image is junk and
a gallery image is correct when its identity equals the query's. Rank-1/5/10/20 and mAP; raw cosine only (a k-reciprocal
rerank over 135k images is outside this study's budget).
PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN (2026-10-07, wave 2):
   H1 (positive control): this script's vectorised metrics equal the unmodified Simple-CCReID evaluate() on a random
      subset of 300 queries (max abs difference of mAP and Rank-1 below 1e-9). FALSIFIED otherwise.
   H2 (non-trivial transfer): Rank-1 exceeds the Rank-1 of a random ranking (identity-prior chance) by at least 20
      percentage points for both encoders. FALSIFIED otherwise. (No training on LaST; a transfer measurement only.)
Intervals: identity-cluster bootstrap (2,000 resamples) over query identities.
usage: python3 -I w2_last.py PULLED_DIR   (last_s0.npz, last_s1.npz)
Outputs results/w2_last.json.
